evidence: The wiki gives Flame Chompers! magic damage as 90 to 290 (+100% AP), the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx).

The wiki says Moonlight Vigil's attacks crit for a scaled 100% to 130% damage, so the game shows a calculated value, but our filled text left @CritDamageModCalc@ unrendered (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aphelios).
The wiki gives Staggering Blow bonus damage as 14 + (116-14)/17 per level, which is 14 to 116, the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nautilus).

The wiki gives Hextech Rocket Swarm initial rocket damage as 135 to 225 (+45% AP), and its combined total of 503 to 892 (+183% AP) matches the tooltip's Max Damage, so it does not match the 60/90/120 in the data (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Heimerdinger).
The wiki says Moonsilver Blade's 15% to 35% (by level) attack speed is tripled to 45% to 105% after casting an ability, the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Diana).

The wiki gives Shock Blast as 80 to 285 (+130% bonus AD), increased by 40% to 112 to 399 (+182% bonus AD) through Acceleration Gate, the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jayce).

The wiki says Power Fist deals 100% AD (+25% AP) bonus physical damage on top of the attack, which is 200% AD +25% AP in total as the tooltip shows, not 175% AD +125% AP (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blitzcrank).
The wiki says the Event Horizon cage stays for 3 seconds, the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Veigar).
The wiki gives Powder Keg's bonus champion damage as 75 to 155, the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gangplank).
The wiki gives Defile's mana restored on kill as 10 to 50, the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Karthus).
The wiki says Wind Becomes Lightning heals for 33.3% of his life steal, which matches the tooltip's rounded 33% and the data's 0.333 (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xin_Zhao).
The wiki gives Rake's return damage as 60 to 180 (+90% bonus AD), the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Talon).
The wiki gives Purge as 12 (+20 to 34% AD) per shot with linear steps (20/23.5/27/30.5/34), the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Urgot).
The wiki gives GNAR! as 200 to 400 (+50% bonus AD) (+100% AP), rising to 300 to 600 (+75% bonus AD) (+150% AP) against walls, the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gnar).
The wiki gives The Culling as 15 to 45 (+25% AD) (+15% AP) per shot, the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lucian).
The wiki gives Winter's Bite as 75 to 255 (+2.5% of Braum's maximum health), the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Braum).

The wiki says Bailout's burn deals 10% of maximum health every 0.25 seconds (rounded up to a game tick) until 0 health, which drains a full bar in about 2.5 to 2.7 seconds, not the 3 seconds in the tooltip; the wiki states no total, so this duration is worked out from its values (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Renata_Glasc).
The wiki says Transfusion's empowered additional healing is reduced to 35% against minions, which contradicts the tooltip's 30% (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vladimir).
The wiki says the redirected elemental deals the same damage, 125/175/225 (+20% AP), for a total of 250/350/450 (+40% AP), the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ornn).
The wiki gives Fox-Fire as 40 to 120 (+40% AP), with later flames dealing 40% of that, 16 to 48 (+16% AP), the same as the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ahri).
